entities.summary: Sebastian Ngmenenso Sandaare is a Ghanaian politician and member of the Seventh Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana representing the Daffiama-Bussie-Issa Constituency in the Upper West Region on the ticket of the National Democratic Congress.
